QUESTION:
Which setting caps the number of jobs that can wait inside the component that decides which consumer reads which partition?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0315] config | partitioner.queue_capacity | version 4.x
# `partitioner.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | tasks |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
queue_capacity = 100
```

---

[d0121] config | coordinator.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `coordinator.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
queue_capacity = 5000
```

---

# `partitioner.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | messages |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
batch_size = 256
```

[d0870] changelog | PaderQueue 1.2 release notes | version 1.2
_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `retention.log_level`: log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

- New option `coordinator.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, in bytes.

- New option `partitioner.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

- New option `quota.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant before an operation is reported as failed.

- New option `coordinator.batch_size`: number of messages the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers processes together in one batch.

- New option `replicator.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

response.content: `coordinator.queue_capacity` in PaderQueue 3.x caps pending tasks in the consumer group coordinator’s queue. Its default is `5000` tasks.
